name: @local/dsh-system-prompt-editor
description: A file-backed, live system-prompt block for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: ~/.dsh/system-prompt.md is read at EVERY prompt assembly (per step), so a write applies to the very next LLM call of every running session — plus read_system_prompt / write_system_prompt agent tools so sessions themselves can read and edit the block. Empty/absent file contributes nothing to the prompt.
